title: Pantheon research signal envelope
description: Canonical producer-to-worker contract for signal_version 1.x. Consumers must accept additive payload fields, but reject unknown envelope fields and unsupported major versions.

signal_id.description: Unique identifier for the signal envelope.

signal_version.description: Semantic version of the signal schema (1.x.y for this major version).

domain.description: Business or research domain producing the signal.

intent.description: Execution or decision intent carried by the signal.

priority.description: Scheduling priority hint for consumer processing.

subject.description: Target entity the signal pertains to.

idempotency_key.description: Unique idempotency key scoped per tenant to prevent duplicate execution.

produced_at.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 with timezone) when the signal was generated by the producer.

effective_at.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 with timezone) when the signal becomes effective, or null for immediate.

expires_at.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 with timezone) after which the signal is no longer valid, or null for indefinite.

producer.description: Identifier of the subsystem, worker, or service that generated the signal.

payload.description: Domain-specific research signal payload containing recommendations, metrics, decision, and evidence.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time string with explicit UTC offset (Z or +-HH:MM).

nullableTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time string with explicit UTC offset or null.

subject.description: Entity subject definition specifying entity type and identifier.

entity_type.description: Type of the target entity (e.g., candidate_site, listing, portfolio).

trace.description: Distributed trace context shared across API and event boundaries.

correlation_id.description: Distributed trace correlation identifier across service boundaries.

causation_id.description: Identifier of the direct cause event or request that triggered this signal.

request_id.description: External or inbound API request identifier.

source_event_id.description: Identifier of the upstream domain event.

job_id.description: Batch or background compute job identifier.

decision.description: Governance and approval decision metadata when a signal triggers execution.

decision_id.description: Identifier of the automated or human decision record.

policy_version.description: Version or identifier of the governance/business policy applied.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the policy engine, service, or human actor authorizing the decision.

approved_at.description: Timestamp when the decision was evaluated and approved.

decision_reason.description: Rationale or rule explanation for the decision.

evidence.description: Model, feature, and lineage evidence attached to the signal.

model_name.description: Name of the ML/statistical model generating the prediction.

model_version.description: Exact version string of the model.

model_alias.description: Deployment alias or stage (e.g. champion, challenger, baseline).

feature_view_version.description: Version identifier of the feature store view.

dataset_snapshot_id.description: Snapshot identifier of the training or inference dataset.

feature_snapshot_time.description: Timestamp of feature materialization or snapshot.

prediction_origin_time.description: Timestamp when the inference was executed.

input_hash.description: Cryptographic hash (e.g., sha256) of input feature vector.

output_hash.description: Cryptographic hash (e.g., sha256) of model output.

evidence_level.description: Confidence or validation level of the evidence (e.g., model_validated, rule_inferred).

metric.description: Metric numeric or string value, or null.

payload.description: Business payload containing recommendations, metrics, decision, and evidence.

recommended_action.description: Recommended operational or execution action name.

score.description: Domain or model score associated with the recommendation.

risk_flags.description: Array of identified risk or warning flags.

constraints.description: Operational or governance constraints applicable to execution.

evidence.description: Lineage and provenance evidence for the recommendation.

details.description: Arbitrary domain-specific detail object; consumers must allow additive keys.
